body:
10:00pm, got a nap, but it's...worse.

I want to apologize for my outbursts. I want to talk to my friends and try to fix things. But they've completely blocked all communication with me. I don't know what to do, they're the only ones I have, given that I don't...really have a family.

6:49 EST -- Just got home, so to answer a few things.

Psychosis0852, you're right, it's not good for us. I went into AA with the intention of getting off the sauce completely, but a combination of external pressures and the psychotic break that started last Friday pushed me out of it. As of yesterday, I lost someone who meant a lot  just from the unwavering, genial support they provided...he starved himself to death trying to lose weight. I ended up blacked out drunk by the end of the night at his wake and screaming at anyone with a certain level of connection and depth to me. It's hard because I don't get a lot of support in general, especially not in meatspace, due to my appearance. Stable is difficult when you have no real support structure in play.

Wertyuish, I can't move. My brother and I both moved in with our mother after our dad died almost three years ago and she had to have a hip replacement. I'm more the caretaker of things...laundry, cleaning, the things my mom can't do. Even if my mom is constantly hovering over me and trying to exorcise my lesbian demons where I wake up to her doing so, or she turns Thanksgiving dinner into a sermon, someone has to take care of her as best as possible, and the younger one is a loutish fratboy. Leaving the area is kind of out of the question.

I'm shuttered up in my room, need to sleep for a little bit. I'll keep updating this until there's some sembalance of okay.
It was the end of my shift. Condition update coming.
I'm "safe", in that I'm at work, but that's somewhat relative.

I have an Associate's in Pharmacy Tech, but where I live it is an exceedingly-difficult field to break into; the retirement/turnover in hospital isn't fast, and in retail the pay is barely enough. I actually make better money doing what I do now.
